purpose: Independently solve the two P0725 fine-grid AQUAL fields with direct nonlinear residual methods and compare them with the converged Picard reference without changing physics or data.

solverVariants.role: default recycled Krylov direction with guarded steps

selectionPolicy: Select the lowest median wall-time Newton-Krylov variant that converges both systems, meets every residual/update gate, and agrees with the locked P0725 Picard reference in potential, acceleration, and predicted circular speeds. Observed speeds do not select the method.
rethinkPolicy: If no Newton-Krylov variant converges and agrees, keep the P0725 Picard solution provisional and preregister Anderson or coefficient-continuation methods; do not loosen the field residual or comparison thresholds.
claimBoundary: This is an independent numerical root cross-check on two spent debugging galaxies, not a new gravity-theory test.
The P0725 converged Picard results are locked references and are not used as Newton-Krylov initial fields.
All variants begin from the same unit-coefficient linearized field and retain the same AQUAL equation, physical parameters, density, grid, and boundary.
Agreement is evaluated in full potential and acceleration grids as well as observation-space predictions.
A pass validates these numerical roots only; it does not establish AQUAL observational adequacy.
